# AI Use-Case Design & Product Ownership — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Frame a business problem as an AI task with a measurable metric
- Write requirements including evaluation criteria and guardrails
- Run discovery with users and data owners
- Own the backlog through delivery

## The sentences to remember

1. **From pain point to AI task — or not AI at all** — “Where does the answer live? If you cannot say, you do not have a use case yet.”
2. **Data and feasibility: score it before you promise it** — “Most AI projects do not fail at the model. They fail at question five: we never had the right answers to test against.”
3. **Write an AI PRD — and lint it** — “If the PRD has no evaluation set, 'done' will be decided by whoever is most tired.”
4. **Prototype without code — and test it with a test sheet** — “A demo shows the three questions that work. A test sheet shows the seven you did not think to ask.”
5. **Running the initiative: gates, stakeholders, adoption** — “Launched is a date. Adopted is a number. Report the number.”
